# i-have-adhd

Shapes replies: next action first, numbered steps, no tangents, no preamble.

- Source: https://github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd (MIT)
- Type: plugin

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add ayghri/i-have-adhd
claude plugin install i-have-adhd@i-have-adhd
```

Use: `/i-have-adhd` per session ("stop adhd mode" to end), or always on with `touch ~/.claude/.i-have-adhd-always`.
